# Jubilees Chapter 49 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Ge'ez MS; cf. 4QJub (Hebrew fragments) | **Section:** The Passover ordinance — detailed halakhic legislation

---

**49:1** Remember the commandment that the LORD commanded you concerning the Passover: you shall celebrate it at its appointed time, on the fourteenth of the first month. You shall slaughter it before evening, and they shall eat it by night on the evening of the fifteenth, from the time of sunset.

**49:2** For it was on this night — the beginning of the festival and the beginning of the joy — that you were eating the Passover in Egypt, when all the powers of Mastema had been let loose to slay all the firstborn in the land of Egypt, from the firstborn of Pharaoh to the firstborn of the captive maidservant at the mill, and the cattle.

**49:3** And this is the sign which the LORD gave them: into every house on whose doorposts they saw the blood of a yearling lamb they did not enter to slay; it passed over them. And for this reason it was called the Passover — because the LORD passed over the houses of the children of Israel.

**49:4** The powers of Mastema — the destroyer — had no power over the children of Israel on that night.

**49:5** The LORD protected the houses of Israel that night from the destroying angel, so that he could not harm any of them — neither their men nor their cattle nor their dogs.

**49:6** The destroying angel did not enter the houses of the children of Israel that night, because the LORD had set a mark upon them.

**49:7** You shall observe this ordinance at its appointed time after you have entered the land which the LORD will give you as an inheritance.

**49:8** Eat it on the fourteenth of the first month, between the evenings, from the third part of the day to the third part of the night; for two portions of the day are given to the light and one third to the evening.

**49:9** This is what the LORD has commanded you. Do not delay from the evening into darkness; eat it at night while it is still being cooked by fire, before it is morning.

**49:10** Do not break any bone of it. For thus it is written and ordained: let nothing of it remain until morning, and let no bone be broken; for it is a feast day, a day of joy.

**49:11** You shall eat it in haste: its head with its legs and its entrails, with unleavened bread and bitter herbs shall you eat it. And you shall drink wine — the blood of the grape.

**49:12** You shall not carry the flesh of the Passover sacrifice outside the gate. You shall not break any bone of it. No uncircumcised person shall eat of it.

**49:13** Every male in Israel shall be circumcised; no uncircumcised male shall eat of the Passover.

**49:14** A resident alien and a hired worker shall not eat of it. And it shall not be carried out of the house to another house, for it is most holy.

**49:15** You shall all eat it together, those who are in one house. Do not eat it outdoors, and do not carry the flesh out of the house.

**49:16** All the children of Israel shall observe it at its appointed time, every year, once a year, on its day — according to the commandment and according to its ordinance.

**49:17** Do not delay the Passover sacrifice beyond the appointed day. It is the Passover of the LORD, and it shall be observed on its day.

**49:18** For I have inscribed it in the heavenly tablets that they shall observe the Passover on the fourteenth of the first month, and that the Passover sacrifice shall be slaughtered before evening.

**49:19** They shall eat it at night on the evening of the fifteenth until the third part of the night; whatever remains of its flesh from the third part of the night onward shall be burned with fire.

**49:20** They shall not boil it in water, nor eat it raw, but roasted over the fire — its head with its legs and its entrails.

**49:21** They shall not break a bone of it. For no bone of the children of Israel shall be broken.

**49:22** Therefore the LORD commanded the children of Israel to observe the Passover on its day and not to break any bone of it.

**49:23** It is a statute forever, ordained in the heavenly tablets; and there is no passing over the commandment.

---

*LOGOS notes: Chapter 49 is the most detailed Passover legislation in the pre-Tannaitic corpus. Jubilees goes beyond the Exodus 12 legislation in specifying exact timing (between the third part of day and third part of night), the role of Mastema in the death of the firstborn (vv.2-4), the wine drinking (v.11), and the absolute prohibition on uncircumcised participants (v.13). The heavenly tablets authority (v.23) places all this beyond revision.*
